t2.thesis: Despite an extreme valuation multiple, strong US commercial AIP momentum and a 6% 5-day pullback into earnings lower the immediate bar for a guidance-driven relief rally.
reasons: Pre-earnings pullback (-6.3% over 5 days) amid broad tech weakness eases tactical positioning hurdles.
Persistent positive call skew (call IV 6.5 vol points above put IV) indicates institutional demand for upside convexity.
Hyper-growth in U.S. commercial revenue (149% YoY last quarter) offers high beat potential against raised Q3 revenue targets.
Valuation at ~72x sales limits upside if full-year guide raises do not significantly surpass whisper numbers.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance and U.S. commercial AIP customer conversion velocity.

prior.from: registry base rate for software_internet cluster (n=919, hit rate 0.541)

t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up +1.9% from 0.541 prior due to constructive call-skew positioning and a 5-day pre-earnings de-risking pullback, offset by extreme valuation sensitivity.

theses.expected: Q3 beat on U.S. commercial expansion accompanied by another full-year guidance raise
theses.mechanism: AIP bootcamps converting rapidly into multi-year enterprise contracts, reaccelerating TCV and operating leverage
theses.wrong_if: Government contract delays or decelerating commercial pipeline additions cause a guidance tap-out

theses.expected: Guidance beats consensus but fails to meet elevated buy-side whisper targets, sparking multiple compression
theses.mechanism: At 72x P/S, investors demand flawless beats; any sign of decelerating sequential growth prompts profit-taking
theses.wrong_if: Management raises FY26 operating income and free cash flow targets well above 60% margins

theses.expected: Post-earnings short squeeze and momentum pop on sovereign AI narrative
theses.mechanism: Positive call open interest and sentiment push retail and systematic buyers into breakout momentum at the open
theses.wrong_if: Macro tech risk aversion and capex fatigue overshadow idiosyncratic execution

key_observations: U.S. commercial revenue growth rate (Q2 was 149% YoY)
Full-year 2026 revenue guidance range revision (prior guide $8.150 - $8.158B)
Q3 GAAP operating income and margin (Q2 GAAP operating margin was 47%)
Remaining deal value (RDV) and closed total contract value (TCV) trajectory
